# MsgAuthPrompt.prompt behavior in mailnews/base/src/MsgAsyncPrompter.sys.mjs

Rejects every save mode except SAVE_PASSWORD_NEVER. Copies a truthy default text into caller's result object, then delegates generic prompt to Services.prompt with chromeWindow and no checkbox label. Realm argument is unused.

## State read

- aSavePassword
- aDefaultText truthiness
- this.chromeWindow

## State changed

- aResult.value before prompt when default text is truthy

## Calls and triggers

- Services.prompt.prompt; underlying prompt service not followed.

## Result and consumers

Returns delegated Boolean result; aResult is the mutable output object.

## Errors

Throws NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for unsupported save modes; prompt service errors propagate.

## Async completion

Synchronous call; service may run modal loop internally, not examined.

## Ownership and cleanup

Caller owns result object; method creates an unused checkbox-state object for the service.
